svg.title: Eleven stress-oriented indicators
svg.desc: Heatmap of eleven component z-scores grouped into markets, banking and monetary conditions, and real-economy distress. Teal indicates below-average stress; burgundy indicates above-average stress. All components use the same color scale from minus four to plus four and no values are clipped. February 1934 is marked by a vertical dashed line.
